summary: Listed as a lookout tower in Tyrrell County on one North Carolina tower list; no other source found describes it.

evidence.quote: List may include a few observation towers and Coast Guard lookouts.

notes_for_editor: Thin. The only evidence is one row in a third-party tower list (tnlandforms.us). The list says it may include observation towers and Coast Guard lookouts, so even the fire-lookout identity is unconfirmed. No NGS mark is listed for this entry. Two WebSearch queries found no Kilkenny tower. A Tyrrell County Forest Service office called Columbia Tower appeared in results, but that is not evidence of a lookout. The story is about 95 words, below the 120-word floor; the editor may want to hold it until a better source turns up.
